headline: Cal State Monterey Bay close on Cal State LA
dek: Cal State Monterey Bay have not lost since September, a run that took them through Cal State San Bernardino, where the leaders Cal State LA were held goalless. Monterey Bay have scored 37 goals and lost twice all season; only Cal State LA, still without a defeat, have lost fewer.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Cal State LA have scored 27 goals, well short of the top of this chart, and have conceded four in fifteen matches without a defeat: the leaders' record is built on what they keep out, not what they put in.

wire.line: Cal State Monterey Bay have won every match they have played in October, the visit to Cal State San Bernardino among them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ten matches have passed their date with no result recorded; the latest, and the only one between conference sides, is Cal Poly Pomona's home match with Fresno Pacific.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State East Bay have conceded 47 goals in sixteen matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Stanislaus State have drawn seven of their seventeen matches, more draws than any other side in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cisco Avila has scored eleven of the 37 goals Cal State San Marcos have scored.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Yoel Vazquez has kept five shutouts in goal for Cal State San Marcos.

last_match.line: The defeat ended UC Merced's winning run since their loss at Stanislaus State; Cal State San Marcos now sit level on points with Cal State Monterey Bay.

next_match.line: Fresno Pacific have scored as many goals as any side in the conference, and have lost to Cal State San Bernardino, Cal State San Marcos and Cal State Monterey Bay.
